capabilities: create self-contained writing projects with predefined folder structures
organize chapters and scenes in a drag-and-drop narrative outline
draft in a distraction-free Focus Mode with session timers and word counts
export projects to PDF and Final Draft (.fdx) screenplay files
provide in-project writing references for characters, narrative, and structure
extras: Under active development with a stated roadmap; includes a no-warranty disclaimer and bundles third-party MIT-licensed assets (PRO Screenwriting Snippet, Lucide Icons).
problem: Obsidian treats notes as flat files, so writers of long-form works like books and scripts lack project-level structure, drafting tools, and screenplay-specific output.
summary: Long-form writing environment that organizes books and screenplays into structured projects with outlines, focus drafting, and export tools.
